onet_gameplay_fix.issue_addressed: Onet grid alignment shift caused by single multi-span tiles
onet_gameplay_fix.solution_design: Strict uniform underlying grid (e.g., 6x8, 8x10). Multi-cell tiles (1x2 or 2x2 visual groups) must strictly be rendered as contiguous cell groupings on fixed grid cells without altering individual cell CSS grid spans or causing sibling shifting. All cell bounding boxes remain identical 1x1 units in CSS grid, and multi-cell tile visual overlays are purely graphic render layers connected to the fixed grid coordinates.

block_puzzle_polish.enhancements: Add dynamic piece preview drag shadows, clear combo score particle bursts, haptic-feel grid placement animations, clear row/column flash beam effects, and emergency booster powerups (Hammer single-block break, Bomb 3x3 blast, Board Shuffle).

component_guidelines.interactive_components: Use custom styled Shadcn primitives (Dialog, Tabs, Progress, Toast/Sonner, Badge) with thick bold borders and bright fill colors.
component_guidelines.testing_requirement: EVERY interactive element (Button, Input, Tab, Modal Trigger, Card, Badge) MUST include a explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='daily-income-progress', data-testid='ledger-invoice-button', data-testid='onet-tile-grid').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Maintain existing React Vite structure in src/ preserving core files like MainLobby.tsx, GameContext.tsx, OnetBoard.tsx, BlockPuzzleScreen.tsx.

2. Ensure Onet tile grid strictly enforces fixed square grid cells (e.g. 50px x 50px per cell) without allowing individual cells to offset or break row alignment when rendering multi-cell grouped visual graphics.
3. Implement Daily Economy Income Limit (100 coins max per day) with a clean Income Ledger / Invoice history modal in Profile/Shop.
4. Add Minigames Hub switcher in Challenge Mode (Onet, Block Rush, Triple Tile Match, Memory Flip).
5. Integrate Avatar customization screen linked with Achievement and Mission completion rewards.
6. Add Dark Theme toggle alongside Light Theme using dark mode CSS variables and Tailwind classes.
7. Include data-testid on all interactive buttons, tiles, cards, modals, and progress bars.
